sentences.en: Good morning everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。

sentences.en: My name's Janet Parker and I'm the human resources manager.
sentences.zh: 我叫珍妮特·帕克，是人力资源经理。

sentences.en: We're very happy to welcome you to your new apprenticeship.
sentences.zh: 我们非常高兴欢迎你们加入新的学徒计划。

sentences.en: I hope that the next six months will be a positive and enjoyable experience for you.
sentences.zh: 希望接下来的六个月对你们来说是一段积极而愉快的经历。

sentences.en: I'd like to start with some general advice about being an apprentice.
sentences.zh: 我想先就如何成为一名学徒提供一些总体建议。

sentences.en: Most of you have very little or a no experience of working for a big organisation and the first week or so may be quite challenging.
sentences.zh: 你们中的大多数人几乎没有或完全没有在大型组织工作的经验，因此最初一两周可能会颇具挑战性。

sentences.en: There will be a lot of new information to take in but don't worry too much about trying to remember everything.
sentences.zh: 你们需要吸收大量新信息，但不必过于担心是否能记住所有内容。

sentences.en: The important thing is to check with someone if you're not sure what to do - you'll find your supervisor is very approachable and won't mind explaining things or helping you out.
sentences.zh: 关键在于：如果不确定该怎么做，请务必向他人确认——你们会发现自己的主管非常平易近人，很乐意解释问题或给予帮助。

sentences.en: You're here to learn so make the most of that opportunity.
sentences.zh: 你们来这里是为了学习，所以请充分利用这一机会。

sentences.en: You'll be spending time in different departments during your first week so make an effort to talk to as many people as possible about their work you'll make some new friends and find out lots of useful information.
sentences.zh: 在第一周，你们将在不同部门轮岗，因此请尽量多与同事交流，了解他们的工作；这样既能结交新朋友，也能获取大量有用信息。

sentences.en: As well as having a supervisor, you'll each be assigned a mentor.
sentences.zh: 除了配备一名主管外，每位学徒还将被指派一位导师。

sentences.en: This person will be someone who's recently completed an apprenticeship and you'll meet with them on a weekly basis.
sentences.zh: 这位导师是近期刚完成学徒计划的人员，你们将每周与其会面一次。

sentences.en: Their role is to provide help and support throughout your apprenticeship.
sentences.zh: 其职责是在整个学徒期间为你们提供帮助与支持。

sentences.en: Of course, this doesn't mean they'll actually do any of your work for you instead they'll be asking you about what goals you've achieved so far, as well as helping you to identify any areas for improvement.
sentences.zh: 当然，这并不意味着他们会替你们完成任何工作；相反，他们将询问你们迄今已实现哪些目标，并协助你们识别需改进的方面。

sentences.en: You can also discuss your more long-term ambitions with them as well.
sentences.zh: 你们也可以与他们探讨自己更长远的职业抱负。

sentences.en: Now just want to run through a few company policies for our apprenticeship scheme with you...
sentences.zh: 接下来，我想向大家简要说明一下我们学徒计划的相关公司政策……

sentences.en: Most importantly, the internet.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是互联网使用规定。

sentences.en: As part of your job you'll be doing some research online so obviously you'll have unlimited access for that but please don't use it for personal use - Dit a D you'll have your own phones for that.
sentences.zh: 作为工作的一部分，你们需在线开展一些调研，因此对此用途享有无限网络访问权限；但请勿将其用于私人用途——你们自有手机可供个人使用。

sentences.en: Mar 5:98 Some of you have already asked me about flexible working.
sentences.zh: 3月5日：98。你们中已有人向我咨询过弹性工作制的问题。

sentences.en: After your probationary three- month period - some of you will be eligible for this - but it will depend on which department you're in and what your personal circumstances are.
sentences.zh: 试用期为三个月，期满后部分人可能符合弹性工作制资格，但这取决于你们所在的部门及个人具体情况。

sentences.en: So please don't assume you'll automatically be permitted to do this.
sentences.zh: 因此，请勿假定自己将自动获准实行弹性工作制。

sentences.en: I want to make sure there's no confusion about our holiday policy.
sentences.zh: 我想确保大家对我们的休假政策没有误解。

sentences.en: Apart from any statutory public holidays we ask that you don't book any holidays until after your six-month apprenticeship has finished.
sentences.zh: 除法定公共假日外，我们要求你们在为期六个月的学徒期结束前不得预订任何假期。

sentences.en: Time off should only be taken if you are unwell.
sentences.zh: 仅当身体不适时方可请假。

sentences.en: Please speak to your supervisor this is going to a be a problem.
sentences.zh: 如有问题，请及时与主管沟通。

sentences.en: You'll be expected to work a 40-hour week but there may be opportunities to do overtime during busy periods.
sentences.zh: 你们需按每周40小时工作制出勤，但在业务繁忙期可能有机会加班。

sentences.en: Although you're not required to do this, it can be a valuable experience - so we advise you to take it up if possible.
sentences.zh: 尽管加班并非强制要求，但它却是一次宝贵的经历——因此，如条件允许，我们建议你们积极参与。

sentences.en: Obviously, we understand that people do have commitments outside work, so if don't worry if there are times when you are unavailable.
sentences.zh: 我们当然理解员工在工作之外也有其他事务安排，因此若有时段无法到岗，请不必担心。

sentences.en: As you know, we don't have a formal dress code here you may wear casual clothes as long as they're practical - and the only restriction for shoes we have is on high heels for health and safety reasons.
sentences.zh: 如你们所知，本公司并无正式着装规范，只要服装实用，即可穿着便装；鞋类唯一限制是出于健康与安全考虑，禁止穿高跟鞋。

sentences.en: Comfortable shoes like trainers are preferable.
sentences.zh: 推荐穿着运动鞋等舒适鞋类。

sentences.en: There's a heavily subsidised canteen on site where you can get hot meals or salads cheaply.
sentences.zh: 园区内设有一家大幅补贴的员工餐厅，你们可在此以优惠价格购买热餐或沙拉。

sentences.en: Snacks and drinks are also provided - so we've decided to introduce a no packed lunch policy.
sentences.zh: 零食和饮料也由公司提供——因此我们决定实施禁止自带午餐的政策。

sentences.en: This iS partly to encourage healthy eating at work and partly to stop people from eating at their workstation, which is unhygienic.
sentences.zh: 此举部分旨在鼓励员工在工作场所健康饮食，部分则是为了防止员工在工位进食，以免造成卫生隐患。

sentences.en: OK moving on to
sentences.zh: 好的，接下来……
